name: GST rates (India)
description: GST rates before and after the September 2025 revision (dairy, laptops, motorcycles, medical oxygen...), with GST compliance deadlines as a distractor.
data_note: Documents and questions written by a teammate (Anuvesha); kept as given (bold markers removed). Every quote validated verbatim and every answer figure checked against its quotes (multi-hop: their difference). Figures were not re-checked against live sources.
sources: gst_rates_pre_sept2025.md | Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) Goods Schedule | Dated: 01-Jan-2024
gst_rates_post_sept2025.md | Press Information Bureau (PIB) Delhi, Ministry of Finance (Release ID: 2163785 & 155151) | Dated: 04-Sep-2025
distractor_gst_exemptions.md | CBIC GST Exemption Notification Guidance Notes | Dated: 01-May-2024
risk_rules: Never quote a pre-September-2025 GST rate as current.
Do not answer rate questions from compliance deadlines.

test_cases.question: What is the GST rate on packaged paneer and curd after the September 2025 revision?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Packaged Paneer & Curd: Exempted (0% GST) to encourage nutritional food affordability.

gold.quote: Packaged Paneer & Curd: Exempted (0% GST) to encourage nutritional food affordability.

stale.quote: Packaged Paneer & Curd: Taxed at 5% GST (when pre-packaged and labelled).

test_cases.question: What is the current GST rate applicable to butter and cheese post-September 2025?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Butter & Cheese: Reduced to 5% GST under the essential dairy rationalisation umbrella.

gold.quote: Butter & Cheese: Reduced to 5% GST under the essential dairy rationalisation umbrella.

test_cases.question: What is the revised GST rate for entry-level motorcycles up to 350cc?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Entry-level Motorcycles (up to 350cc): Reduced to 18% GST to promote mass commuter mobility.

gold.quote: Entry-level Motorcycles (up to 350cc): Reduced to 18% GST to promote mass commuter mobility.

stale.quote: Entry-level Motorcycles (up to 350cc): Taxed at 28% GST (plus applicable compensation cess where designated).

test_cases.question: What is the GST rate for laptops and personal computers after September 2025?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Laptops & Personal Computers: Reduced to 12% GST to foster educational technology adoption.

gold.quote: Laptops & Personal Computers: Reduced to 12% GST to foster educational technology adoption.

stale.quote: Laptops & Personal Computers: Taxed at 18% GST.

test_cases.question: What is the revised GST rate on solar water heaters post September 2025?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Standard Solar Water Heaters: Increased to 18% GST under unified green energy hardware alignment.

gold.quote: Standard Solar Water Heaters: Increased to 18% GST under unified green energy hardware alignment.

stale.quote: Standard Solar Water Heaters: Taxed at 12% GST.

test_cases.question: What is the current GST rate on medical oxygen and concentrators?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Medical Oxygen & Concentrators: Reduced to 5% GST under essential life-support healthcare provisions.

gold.quote: Medical Oxygen & Concentrators: Reduced to 5% GST under essential life-support healthcare provisions.

stale.quote: Medical Oxygen & Concentrators: Taxed at 12% GST.

test_cases.question: What is the aggregate turnover threshold for mandatory E-invoicing applicability?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: E-invoicing is mandatory for all registered businesses with an aggregate turnover exceeding ₹5 Crore in any preceding financial year.

test_cases.question: What is the monthly due date for filing GSTR-3B summary returns?
